title: Hiro Mashima's Dead Rock Manga Goes on Hiatus, Returns With New Arc This Winter
content: The June issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Magazine published the final chapter of the "Academy Arc" for Hiro Mashima 's DEAD ROCK manga on Thursday. The manga will go on hiatus before returning with a new "Godfall" arc this winter.
author: ANN

title: Tokyo 7th Sisters Idol Raising Smartphone Game Ends Service After 12 Years
content: The official website for Donuts ' Tokyo 7th Sisters idol raising smartphone game announced on Thursday that the game will end service on August 12, 12 years after it launched in February 2014. The game's main story will end with the story for the "Stella MiNE" group in the game's current "Episode 2053" story arc.
author: ANN

title: 'Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru' TV Anime Adaptation Airs in 2026
content: WWWaveCorporation 's Deregula label announced a television anime adaptation of Shaoh 's Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ( I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ) web manga on Friday, revealing a commemorative illustration drawn by the original creator (pictured). The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner! Short Anime Airs on TV This Year
content: The staff for the short anime of Shaoh 's I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ! ( Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ) manga announced on Friday that the anime will be on television, and will premiere this year. Shaoh provided a new illustration (seen below) to celebrate the anime.
author: ANN

title: 26 Years Later, This One Piece Character Is Still Loved Among Fans Worldwide
content: While the Elbaph Arc in the One Piece manga has been ongoing for a while, the anime only commenced it in April this year. The series returned after a three-month hiatus, giving the anime studio more time to prepare for the most exciting arc of the story so far.

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest New Anime’s Producer Debunks Major Production Rumor
content: Witch Hat Atelier made its highly anticipated debut on Crunchyroll as part of the Spring 2026 lineup. The The Spring 2026 anime season debuts the highly anticipated anime adaptation of Witch Hat Atelier , which was supposed to debut last year but was delayed due to production issues.

title: New Shonen Jump Series Debuts to “Disastrous” Reception
content: Thanks to the success of several long-running classics such as Dragon Ball, One Piece, Naruto, Bleach , etc., Weekly Shonen Jump became the best-selling manga magazine of all time. Launched in 1968, the magazine has serialized countless incredible manga series and one-shots over the decades.
author: ComicBook

title: Studio Ghibli Unveils Release Date of Hayao Miyazaki’s New Collection
content: Studio Ghibli is known for many iconic and beloved anime films, most of which have been directed by Hayao Miyazaki. He is one of the most celebrated directors in Japanese history, praised for taking his films to a global audience.
